s: strI, idam Sabdasya strIliNge praTamAyAM rUpaM । ei strI iti BAzA । iti vyAkaraRam ॥

m: इयध्यै (Ved. inf. of √ 5. इ), to come, RV. vi, 20, 8.
इय—च्-चिरम् (इयच्-चिरम्), ind. so long, such a time, Kathās.

इयक्ष् (anom. Desid. of √ यज्) P. इयक्षति (Subj. 3. pl. इयक्षान्, RV. x, 50, 3; p. इयक्षत्) Ā. (p. इयक्षमाण, RV. i, 123, 10; VS. xvii, 69) to go towards, approach; to request, endeavour to gain; to long for, seek, RV.; VS.

v: tri॰ yaja + sana u vede ni saMprasAraRam । yazwumicCO “Danvanniva prApA asi tvamagna iyakzave” f॰ 10, 4, 1, vede prAyeRa sarvatra ni॰ saMprasA॰ । “sumnaM vAM sUrirvfzaRAviyakzan” 1, 152, 2, devAnAM iyanmano yajamAna iyakzati” f॰ 8, 31, 115
m: इयक्षु mfn. Ved. longing for, seeking to gain, RV. x, 4, 1.
a: इयक्षु — a. Ved. Longing for, seeking to gain.

m: इयम् f. nom. sg. of the demonstrative pronoun इदम्, q.v.

v: tri॰ i--karttari asun kicca । 1 gantari BAve asun । 2 gatO “tezAM hEyasevAsa kimiha karttavyam” Sata॰ brA॰ 2, 2, 3, 3

m: इयस्य (anom. Intens. of √ यस्) Ā. इयस्यते, to relax, weaken; to vanish, ŚBr.

s: tri, (idam parimARamasya । idam + vatup vasya yaH .) kiyatsaMKyAboDakam । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ eto iti BAzA । (yaTA, raGuvaMSe । 13 । 67 । “iyanti varzARi tayA sahogra maByasyatIva vratamAsiDAram” .)
v: tri॰ idaM parimARamasya idam--vatup । etAvadarTe “nItaM yadi navanItaM kiyaditi yaSodayA pfzwaH । iyaditi gurujanasaviDe viDftaDanizWApayoDaraH pAyAt” udBawaH । “iyAn vAva kila paSuryAvatI vapA” Eta॰ “iyanti varzARi taTA mahogram” raGuH “dfzwiM nikzipatIti viSvamiyatA manyAmahe duHsTitam” sA॰ da॰ । atra sADanaprakAraH idam + parimARArTe vatup vasya GaH idama iS “yasyeti” pA॰ prakftIkAralope pratyayamAtrasTitiH । ataevAtra vEyAkaraRA OpanizadASca paWanti । “uditavati parasmin pratyaye SAstrayonO gatavati vilayaYca prAkfte'pi prapaYce । sapadi padamudItaM kevalaM pratyayotTaM tadiyaditi mirmIte kohfdA paRqito'pi” । striyAM NIp ।
m: इयत् mfn. (fr. pronominal base 3. इ), so large, only so large
of such extent, RV.; TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; Pañcat.; Ragh. &c.;
इयत्, [cf. the syllable iens or ies in such Lat. words as totiens, toties, quotiens, quoties, and in numeral adverbs as quinquies.]
a: इयत् — a. So much, so large, of this extent; इयत्तवायुः Dk. 93; इयंति वर्षाणि तया सहोग्रं R. 13. 67 so many years; द्बयं नीतिरितीयती Śi. 2. 30 this much; इयतो दिवसानुत्सव आसीत् U. 1

s: strI, (iyat + tal .) iyato BAvaH । sImA । parimARam । saNKyA । ityAdi ॥ (“SrameRa tadaSaktyA vA na guRAnAmiyattayA” । iti raGuvaMSe । 10 । 32 .)
v: strI iyato BAvaH tal । 1 sImAyAM, 2 parimARe, 3 saMKyAyAYca । “na guRAnAmiyattayA” “yaSaH paricCettumiyattayAlam” “I ktayA rUpamiyattayA vA” iti ca raGuH ।
m: इयत्—ता, f. or इयत्—त्व, n. the state of being, of such extent, quantity, fixed measure or quantity, so much, Ragh.; Kād. &c.
a: इयत्ता, इयत्त्वं — 1 (a) So much, fixed measure or quantity; ईदृक्तया रूपमियत्तया वा R. 13. 5; न… यशः परिच्छेत्तुमियत्तयालं 6. 77; K. 129, 182. (b) Limited number, limitation न गुणानामियत्तया R. 10. 32. --2 Limit, standard.

v: strI kutsitA iyattA kutsitArTe kan hrasvaH । kUtsiteyattAyAm । tataH arSa A॰ astyarTe ac । kutsiteyattAyute alpapramARe “iyattakaM kuzumBakaskakaM BinadmyaSmanA” f॰ 1, 191, 15

m: इयत्—तक (इयत्˚), mf(इका)n. so small, so little, RV. i, 191, 11; 15.
a: इयत्तक — a. So small, very small. --का A bad limit.
